verdict.rationale: Evidence shows MX publishes its own MCP server (docs.mx.com/mcp) so external agents can call MX's tools, but this is the opposite role from the story, which asks whether MX itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. There is no documentation of MX acting as an MCP client or any mechanism for feeding third-party MCP tool servers into MX's own workflows or its conversational AI feature.
